description: Returns the account's compliance dossier for a period: one row per licensed article, with article metadata, licence terms, public-record attestation and compliance flags (the signed attestation, CDSM Article 4(3) and text-and-data-mining reservations). At most 90 days per call; longer periods are paginated with _meta.next_cursor. Each call is recorded in the account's audit log. Requires a buyer API key with the 'audit' scope, a buyer session, or the Opedd connector sign-in.

to.description: ISO 8601 timestamp upper bound (inclusive). Window cap 90 days.

name: get_compliance_dossier
title: Get your compliance dossier
